text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are trading with mild upside momentum, both up under 1% in 24 hours while the broader altcoin set shows mixed direction, suggesting measured confidence rather than euphoria. Fear & Greed at 66 indicates greed territory with a week-long uptick, and Bitcoin dominance holding near 59% signals investors are rotating into alts alongside the majors. The $89B in daily volume is solid without being exceptional, pointing to steady accumulation interest rather than panic-driven or FOMO-driven extremes.
